payload.body_you:
You begin noticing what has already ended, even when the habit, paperwork, or emotional attachment has not caught up. The role you no longer believe in. The project you keep reopening out of guilt. The method that once worked and now gives less back every time you use it. Saturn moving through your 12th house makes unfinished endings harder to ignore.

Finish what can be finished. Close the account. Complete the paperwork. Leave the role properly. Admit when a plan has ended instead of keeping it alive through maintenance alone. You may need more privacy and more rest, but that does not mean disappearing from your life. Keep the responsibilities that still belong to you. Stop feeding the ones that are already over.
